wagon.translation: n. 四轮马车, 货车\n[法] 囚车, 马车, 运货车

examples.en: His wagon drew up at the entrance to the market.
When Yanni left Skura, she fell off the wagon hard.
Tom has been on the wagon for three years.

wnsyn.desc: any of various kinds of wheeled vehicles drawn by an animal or a tractor
a child's four-wheeled toy cart sometimes used for coasting

waiter.definition: n. a person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)\nn. a person who waits or awaits

examples.en: Soon the same waiter came back to pick up the dishes.
examples.zh: 不久，同样的服务员回来拿起菜。

examples.en: I need a waiter to help me order.
examples.zh: 我需要一位服务员帮助我点餐。

examples.en: He is a waiter in a seaside restaurant.
examples.zh: 他是一家海滨餐厅的服务员。

wnsyn.desc: a person whose occupation is to serve at table (as in a restaurant)

waitress.translation: n. 女侍者, 女服务员

examples.en: Waitress, I'd like to order.
examples.zh: 服务生，我要点菜。

examples.en: This pub has very beautiful waitresses.
examples.zh: 这个酒吧的女服务员很漂亮。

wallet.definition: n. a pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money
wallet.translation: n. 皮夹\n[法] 皮包, 皮夹, 钱袋

examples.en: He took out the wallet from his inside jacket pocket.
examples.zh: 他从他外套内袋里拿出皮夹。

examples.en: I have looked everywhere, but I cannot find my wallet.
examples.zh: 我到处都看了，可还是没找到我的皮夹。

examples.en: Tom took out his wallet and paid the bill.
examples.zh: 汤姆拿出钱包付了账。

wnsyn.desc: a pocket-size case for holding papers and paper money

warmth.definition: n. the quality of having a moderate degree of heat
warmth.translation: n. 温暖, 温情, 暖和, 激动, 生气

examples.en: He was bathed in the warmth of the kind light.
examples.zh: 亲切的灯光让他的身上充满了温暖的感觉。

wnsyn.desc: the quality of having a moderate degree of heat

wasp.definition: n. a white person of Anglo-Saxon ancestry who belongs to a Protestant denomination\nn. social or solitary hymenopterans typically having a slender body with the abdomen attached by a narrow stalk and having a formidable sting
wasp.translation: n. 黄蜂, 胡蜂, 易怒的人, 刻毒的人\n[医] 胡蜂, 黄蜂

examples.en: Yanni found bits of a dead wasp inside the fig.
The moment I opened the window, a wasp flew in.
During the night, a wasp stung me in the temple.

wnsyn.desc: a white person of Anglo-Saxon ancestry who belongs to a Protestant denomination

wasteful.definition: a. tending to squander and waste\ns. laying waste
wasteful.translation: a. 浪费的, 不经济的

examples.en: It's wasteful to leave the land lying idle.
examples.zh: 让土地闲置著很浪费。

watchful.definition: a engaged in or accustomed to close observation\ns experiencing or accompanied by sleeplessness
watchful.translation: a. 注意的, 警戒的, 警醒的, (时间)醒着换过的

examples.en: The children played under the wet nurse's watchful eye.
He was watchful for any sign of diabetes.
Not a single mistake escaped his watchful gaze.

watery.definition: s. filled with water\ns. relating to or resembling or consisting of water\ns. overly diluted; thin and insipid
watery.translation: a. 水的, 湿的, 平淡的, 稀薄的, 水淋淋的

examples.en: My eyes are watery.
examples.zh: 我的眼里噙满泪水。

wnsyn.desc: overly diluted

watt.definition: n. a unit of power equal to 1 joule per second; the power dissipated by a current of 1 ampere flowing across a resistance of 1 ohm\nn. Scottish engineer and inventor whose improvements in the steam engine led to its wide use in industry (1736-1819)
watt.translation: n. 瓦(特)\n[化] 瓦; 瓦特

examples.en: The watt is the International System of Units' standard unit of power.
The lamp consumed 480 watts giving an efficiency of about 15 lumens per watt.
All the common electric lamps (less than 70 watts) are made with vacuums inside.

wnsyn.desc: Scottish engineer and inventor whose improvements in the steam engine led to its wide use in industry (1736-1819)
a unit of power equal to 1 joule per second

wavelength.definition: n. the distance (measured in the direction of propagation) between two points in the same phase in consecutive cycles of a wave\nn. a shared orientation leading to mutual understanding

examples.en: I guess Tom and I aren't on the same wavelength.
I really feel like we're on the same wavelength.
Violet light has a shorter wavelength than red light.

waver.definition: n. someone who communicates by waving\nn. the act of moving back and forth\nv. sway to and fro
waver.translation: n. 动摇, 踌躇, 挥动者\nvi. 摇摆, 颤抖, 摆动, 摇曳, 犹豫

examples.en: A fishing light wavers under the lee of an island.
She wavers, she dithers: in one word, a woman.
It's clear that your love for him hasn't wavered.

wnsyn.desc: the act of moving back and forth
sway from side to side

wax.definition:
n. any of various substances of either mineral origin or plant or animal origin; they are solid at normal temperatures and insoluble in water
v. cover with wax
v. go up or advance
v. increase in phase
wax.translation: n. 蜡, 蜡状物, 一阵发怒, 增加, (月亮)渐盈\nvi. 变大, 增大, 月亮渐满\nvt. 上蜡于

examples.en: The bees close the cells with a film of wax.
Tom sealed the letter with wax using his signet ring.
The ear has a lot of wax in it.

wnsyn.desc: go up or advance
increase in phase

weaver.definition: n. a craftsman who weaves cloth\nn. finch-like African and Asian colonial birds noted for their elaborately woven nests

examples.en: The spring season is normally very busy for Iowa real estate broker Georgia Weaver.
I pick weaver ant's nests.
Tibetan rug weavers use traditional designs and knotting. Hence their rugs have a simple, natural look.

wnsyn.desc: finch-like African and Asian colonial birds noted for their elaborately woven nests

weekday.definition: n. any day except Sunday (and sometimes except Saturday)
weekday.translation: n. 周日, 平日\n[计] 工作日

examples.en: The weekdays are: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.
examples.zh: 工作日是：周一，周二，周三，周四，和周五。

weekly.definition: n. a periodical that is published every week (or 52 issues per year)\ns. of or occurring every seven days
weekly.translation: n. 周刊, 周报\na. 每周的, 一周一次的, 周刊的\nadv. 每周, 一周一次

examples.en: I log into Tatoeba weekly.
examples.zh: 我每周登录 tatoeba 一次。

examples.en: My dad gives me a weekly allowance that I use to buy comics and ice cream.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每周给我零用钱，我会用来买漫画书和冰激凌。

wnsyn.desc: of or occurring every seven days

weep.definition: v shed tears because of sadness, rage, or pain
weep.translation: n. 哭, 哭泣\nvi. 哭泣, 流泪, 哀悼, 滴落\nvt. 哭着使..., 悲叹, 滴下

examples.en: The cut is no longer weeping and is starting to heal.
examples.zh: 伤口已不流脓, 渐渐愈合了

examples.en: My mother did nothing but weep.
examples.zh: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。

examples.en: She wept all the night.
examples.zh: 她哭了一整晚。

weld.definition:
n. United States abolitionist (1803-1895)
n. a metal joint formed by softening with heat and fusing or hammering together
v. join together by heating
v. unite closely or intimately
weld.translation: n. 焊接处, 焊接\nvt. 焊接, 使密接, 使结合, 使成整体\nvi. 焊牢

examples.en: Tom said that he thought Mary knew how to weld.
Achieving a nice weld bead is not within everyone's reach!
Ziri can weld a lot quicker than Rima.

wnsyn.desc: United States abolitionist (1803-1895)

westward.translation: n. 朝西的方向\na. 向西的\nadv. 向西的

What is motivating Erdogan's westward shift?

wnsyn.desc: toward the west

v. provide with a wharf
v. store on a wharf
v. discharge at a wharf
v. moor at a wharf

examples.zh: 无论结果会是怎样，我也不会改变我的计划。

examples.zh: 不管我做什么，她都说我能做得更好。

examples.en: Whatever he may say, I won't change my mind.
examples.zh: 无论他说甚么，我也不会改变主意。

whenever.translation: conj. 每当\nadv. 不论何时, 每逢

examples.en: Whenever he comes up to Tokyo, he stays with us.
examples.zh: 他每次来东京的时候都会在我们这儿过夜。

examples.en: Dinner is ready, so we can eat whenever we want.
examples.zh: 晚餐已经准备好了，我们可以随时开始吃。

examples.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
examples.zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。

examples.en: Tom always carries a camera with him wherever he goes.
examples.zh: 汤姆无论到哪里都带着照相机。

examples.en: It's like my tail; wherever I go, it goes.
examples.zh: 它就像我的尾巴一样，我去哪里它就去哪里。

examples.en: Put those flowers wherever we can see them well.
examples.zh: 这些花放在哪里也没关系，显眼就行了。

wnsyn.desc: where in the world

examples.zh: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。

examples.en: You can buy whichever you like, but not both.
examples.zh: 你喜欢哪个就买哪个,但不能两个都买。

examples.en: You can take whichever road you like.
examples.zh: 你可以走任何你喜欢的路。

whilst.translation: conj. 当...的时候, 和...同时, 虽然, 只要, 然而, 而, 尽管

examples.zh: 上大学的时候，小王担任过班长。

examples.en: The performers danced whilst singing - they performed extremely well.
examples.zh: 演员们一边唱，一边跳，表演得好极了。

examples.en: Every other day I go with a friend; we lift weights whilst chatting together.
examples.zh: 我每隔一天就跟一个好朋友一起去，我们一起一边谈话一边举重。

examples.zh: 这瓶内有一点威士忌。

examples.zh: 这种威士忌太烈了。

examples.zh: “旗袍”这个词语在中国北方广为使用。

wnsyn.desc: a woman whose husband is dead especially one who has not remarried

examples.en: His wilful ignorance was more than she could stand.
That was a wilful decision, not an accident.
She's always been a wilful child, refusing rules.

willow.definition: n. any of numerous deciduous trees and shrubs of the genus Salix\nn. a textile machine having a system of revolving spikes for opening and cleaning raw textile fibers
willow.translation: n. 柳树, 柳木制品\na. 柳树的, 柳木制的

winding.definition:

v form into a wreath
v raise or haul up with or as if with mechanical help
s marked by repeated turns and bends
s of a path e.g.

examples.zh: 重庆是一座丘陵的城市，道路弯弯曲曲的。

examples.zh: 天气很冷，而且风很大。

examples.zh: 虽然外面风很大，但是我们还是会出去散步。

winner.definition: n. the contestant who wins the contest\nn. a gambler who wins a bet
winner.translation: n. 胜利者, 优胜者\n[法] 取胜者

examples.en: The winner of this quarter-final match will advance to the semi-final stage.
examples.zh: 这场四分之一决赛的胜者将晋级半决赛。

examples.zh: 做个赢家很好。

examples.zh: 优胜者不使用药物。

wireless.definition: n. transmission by radio waves\na. having no wires
wireless.translation: n. 无线电\na. 无线的, 无线电的

examples.zh: 要不要买个无线鼠标呢？

woe.translation: n. 悲哀, 悲痛, 苦痛

examples.zh: 悲哉失败者!

woodpecker.definition: n. bird with strong claws and a stiff tail adapted for climbing and a hard chisel-like bill for boring into wood for insects

woollen.definition: n a fabric made from the hair of sheep\na of or related to or made of wool
woollen.translation: n. 毛织品\na. 羊毛制的

examples.zh: 她买了件羊毛套衫给他。

workman.definition: n. an employee who performs manual or industrial labor
workman.translation: n. 工人, 工匠, 男工

wnsyn.desc: an employee who performs manual or industrial labor

world-wide.definition: s involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope\ns spanning or extending throughout the entire world\ns of worldwide scope or applicability

worthless.definition: a. lacking in usefulness or value

examples.zh: 一辆车龄八年的车子几乎是毫无价值的。

examples.zh: 父亲生前留下来的老古董，原来只是一堆不值钱的垃圾。

wreath.definition: n. flower arrangement consisting of a circular band of foliage or flowers for ornamental purposes
wreath.translation: n. 花圈, 花环, 圈状物\n[医] 花冠, 花冠体(细胞核分裂的一时期)

examples.zh: 我们在前门上挂了一个圣诞花圈。

examples.en: Flowers and wreaths were laid in front of the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.
examples.zh: 在无名战士的墓前献上了鲜花和花圈。

examples.en: The girl in the picture has a flower wreath on her head, and not a golden crown.
examples.zh: 画中的女孩头上戴著的是花冠，不是金皇冠。

wnsyn.desc: flower arrangement consisting of a circular band of foliage or flowers for ornamental purposes

wring.definition: v. twist and compress, as if in pain or anguish\nv. twist, squeeze, or compress in order to extract liquid
wring.translation: n. 扭绞, 拧, 挤\nvt. 拧, 绞, 扭, 勒索, 折磨, 使痛苦\nvi. 蠕动, 扭动, 绞, 扭, 感到痛苦

n. letters or symbols that are written or imprinted on a surface to represent the sounds or words of a language
writing.translation: n. 书写, 著作, 笔迹, 作品\n[医] 书写

examples.zh: 我从两点开始写呀写呀，一分钟也没休息过。

examples.zh: 在他的文章中总是有太多肤浅的桥段。

examples.zh: 汤姆正给他的好友写信。
